sourceReviews.text:
ISSUES. One P3 finding in the modern crop actor's upper-height check. No additional actionable defect was identified in the original-authority Engine port or retained receipt/input protocol. R4's original Engine authority condition is satisfied in the inspected source, subject to the finding below. This candidate is not source CLEAN as a whole.

There is also a closing integration hold: canonical acquired new peer-follow methods in both MovementController files during review. Those changes postdate the frozen crop baselines and must be preserved when root installs the candidate. Their current callers would lose the required method if these frozen MovementController files simply replaced canonical. This drift is reported separately from the crop defect.

Reviewed source: `/tmp/lodekeeper-crop-original-authority-root-r1/source`, exactly 37 production paths: 35 Java files and two native locks. Patch SHA256 `79e647170c1eb50a9ef876aa547dcbd2d5bbe1efae99f51bc555c4e009c8d18e`. Candidate compiler, tests and native behavior are UNRUN. FULL11 and client acceptance remain open.

**P3: a valid 26.3 crop at the maximum build height is excluded.** [CropHarvestAction.java:626](/tmp/lodekeeper-crop-original-authority-root-r1/source/fabric-modern/src/main/java/dev/lodekeeper/fabric/modern/CropHarvestAction.java:626) rejects `pos.getY() >= client.level.getMaxY()` in its loaded helper.

The actual pinned 26.3 `LevelHeightAccessor.getMaxY()` returns `getMinY() + getHeight() - 1`, the last valid block height. Its `isInsideBuildHeight(int)` accepts that maximum and rejects values greater than it. I verified the method bodies directly from the cached class bytes using Python ZIP/constant-pool/Code parsing, without a Java process or class execution. Cached jar: `/Users/luinbytes/src/lodekeeper/.gradle/loom-cache/minecraftMaven/net/minecraft/minecraft-merged-7e9a32a5b8/26.3/minecraft-merged-7e9a32a5b8-26.3.jar`, SHA256 `9efea1f5fc02fd49f34607cbac755671d905acdaa933dc20ff0596c100a1d2c4`. Class entry `net/minecraft/world/level/LevelHeightAccessor.class` SHA256 `0c8aef17fd48078a0b1448658881bd463f54f705ca748beb60f727fc165d79ee`.

Trigger: a mature supported crop at the maximum valid Y, on farmland one block below, with loaded chunks, permission, ordinary stock and a safe reachable stance inside the bounded search. Normal overworld coordinates are crop Y=319 and farmland Y=318. Search lines 221–225 always skip that crop before checking maturity or admitting an approach. The same helper gates later target and planting observations. This establishes an incorrect refusal in source; no native crop failure or unsafe send was observed. Travel R4 repaired its own height helper, but this crop helper remains separate.

Smallest proper repair: replace the manual min/max expression with `!client.level.isInsideBuildHeight(pos)`, retaining the null, world-border and loaded-chunk checks. The exact modern GameApi already uses that predicate at [GameApi.java:141](/tmp/lodekeeper-crop-original-authority-root-r1/source/fabric-modern/src/26.3/java/dev/lodekeeper/fabric/modern/GameApi.java:141). Preserve the primary actor's Yarn `isOutOfHeightLimit` check. Root should compile the repaired exact-family source and include this boundary in its previously authorized crop verification work. No test or test file was added here.

**Read-only scope and evidence.** Only this report was written. Candidate, canonical, lineage and obsolete worktree source were untouched by this reviewer. No Git command, build, javac, javap, test, native client, app/service restart, memory access or nested agent was used. Read-only Python inspected hashes, class bytes and in-memory patch/text reconstructions. None of the author's staging or audit scripts was executed or imported.

The actual anti-AI skill, pstack host runtime and poteto-mode skill were read, with investigation/how and prose guidance. The explicit review scope overrides their reproduction, editing, delegation, Git and delivery defaults. No user questions were asked.

The review read the original crop/fluid brief and design; frozen R1/R2/R3 crop reports, reviews, findings/responses and retained closure/input contracts; the whole terminal R4 crop review; latest original Travel R4/R4c/R4d and animal Engine source context. Actual animal authority, AIR, cancellation and stock code, native input handlers, packet receipts and family/build selection were inspected where they meet this integration. All three root scripts were read in full as code: `/tmp/lodekeeper-stage-crop-original-authority-r1.py`, `/tmp/lodekeeper-continue-crop-staging-r1.py` and `/tmp/lodekeeper-port-crop-engine-original-authority-r1.py`. ROOT-PORT.md, state.json, final-source-manifest.json and every Engine conflict response were compared with actual final source.

**Exact reconstruction.** Final manifest, state and actual source path sets agree on all 37 paths. Every final source digest and captured original canonical baseline matches actual bytes. The three new files have null baselines: their empty captured files do not mean that empty canonical source existed. The actual new canonical files remain absent at the closing check.

All 37 final patch sections were independently applied in memory with exact old context/deletion matching, hunk positions, counts and preserved tails; all outputs equal staged bytes. No fuzzy matching or author audit execution was used. Measured patch size is 4,442 lines and 289,029 bytes, with 166 hunks, 2,986 additions and 138 deletions. The measured byte count differs by two from the task's 289,027-byte description; the actual patch digest matches the final manifest.

Captured crop baseline/candidate trees match frozen R4, including historical absences. All 2,129 R4 manifest entries were independently hashed, with a final repeat before this report. The original-to-R4 37-path patch and R3-to-R4 16-path delta were independently reconstructed against retained predecessors. R4 changes exactly the declared 16 input/helper paths; its Engine delta is empty.

Root's final 37 files comprise 21 exact R4 files, eight additive GameApi ports, six clean three-way helper ports and two original-authority Engine ports. Removing precisely the original crop seam insertion from each of the eight final GameApi files yields its complete captured current canonical file. This proves retention of the current Travel helpers and other API changes. The clean MovementController, NativeRun and PlayerActions mirror merges were independently reconstructed from non-overlapping old/crop/current differences and equal final bytes. Both complete Engine diffs—587 primary and 605 modern lines—and all 22 conflict responses, 11 per mirror, were read. Older direct AcquireRequest fields were translated to current stable view/demand rather than copied from an old Engine.

Both native locks were checked against actual candidate-overlaid canonical sources: 51 primary and 52 modern rows. Only the two InputOverrideHandler rows change. The other 101 rows remain exact. The added handler observations preserve installation, native tick, key maps and restoration. Dependency/source-lock pins, license, notices and source-access packaging are not replaced by this candidate. Source/hash checks supply no artifact, compiler or runtime credit.

**Closing canonical drift.** Earlier checks matched all 37 live canonical baselines. The check immediately before report creation found two subsequent changes: primary and modern MovementController each gained a 25-line `followGoalSettled(Entity, UUID)` method. The actual diff contains only that additive method in each file. Their current TravelAction callers are at `/Users/luinbytes/src/lodekeeper/fabric/src/main/java/dev/lodekeeper/fabric/TravelAction.java:194` and its modern mirror at line 194. The frozen crop candidate lacks those methods. Its preservation proof therefore applies to the recorded canonical baselines, not to these later peer repairs.

Root must preserve the new helpers and their peer-follow integration while applying the crop MovementController deltas, then regenerate the relevant final hashes/locks or source manifest as appropriate and compile the resulting union. No kernel-lock source changed in this observed drift. This review does not assess or claim runtime success for the new peer helper. Canonical Git was not queried; `5108f5b873d55d9d77fc086a63ee34568f03aa2d` remains the recorded staging base, not a claim about the current tip.

**Original authority and debt permissions.** P/M below identify the primary/modern candidate AutomationEngine; actor line references use the corresponding CropHarvestAction.

Engine P:1957–2006 / M:2324–2373 captures the original AcquisitionScope, stable view, parent Request, PlanIdentity, JobContext, step, catalog, phase generation, plan serial, catalog generation, protection epoch and native-policy generation. Admission receives the original context's owner, native Session and provenance Session. It does not fresh-capture a replacement context/token or derive authority from whichever parent later becomes active.

The crop hold is installed before actor begin at P:1994–2002 / M:2361–2369 so the closures called by begin see the actual original witness. The guard rejects any retained native actor. False begin clears only this newly installed hold and pauses. Original ownership at P:2008–2022 / M:2375–2389 checks the same parent, scope/view, plan object/serial, step, catalog object/generation, original context, local issuer and runtime/session/player/network binding. New scope/plan/catalog/context or observed policy revocation invalidates it; actor rights loss stays latched.

New effects at P:2035–2038 / M:2402–2405 additionally require `newEffectCurrent`, `planIdentityCurrent`, no foreground yield, runtime safety and hunger availability. Persistent ownership avoids those whole new-effect predicates so cancellation/deadline can retain permission to settle original debt.

Separate REPAIR/CLEANUP CropDebtPermission instances capture the exact original scope/plan/context, real local player UUID and original grant epoch zero. Initial admission requires original protection allowBreak/allowPlace and rejects nonzero remote grant epochs. Debt evaluation P:2040–2046 / M:2407–2413 compares the appropriate captured permission by identity, validates its scope/plan/context/issuer/epoch and requires original ownership plus runtime safety. These are concrete local permissions for this scope's own settlement, not constant suppliers or a fresh remote grant.

Actor checks add exact captured protection/native-policy epochs, original restored input, current menu/cursor, all slot/component stock, and native movement/process ownership. First drain freezes repair eligibility to an actually issued harvest with an already reserved planting unit. No issued harvest means no manufactured repair. Cycle expiry blocks an unsent replant. Captured cleanup does not bypass survival, policy, stock, native ownership or the original hand state.

The broad guards use `nativeAcquisitionActive = animal || crop` in planning, transactions, finish, reset, optional Travel preparation, survival, equipment and disposal. Reset P:5477–5518 and the corresponding modern method retain the actor before clearing step/context. Resume neither recaptures crop authority nor resets its job budget. Current scope creation sites install a replacement scope; plan serial/current scope and view checks prevent stale phase/plan reuse. Recovery/replan cannot erase a retained actor merely to resume ordinary work.

**Receipts and retained flows.** One PlacementProvenance listener at Engine P:500–503 and its modern counterpart fans out the actual server block receipt to Backfill first, then the retained crop actor. Backfill has no competing registration. Native packet TAIL callbacks, current source/connection binding and server slot snapshots remain the receipt sources; local prediction does not create a recorded receipt.

Break/use/SWAP callbacks latch possible-send state before the actual native attempt. Proof requires later real monotonic block/inventory sequences at exact crop/farmland cells. Planting requires a fresh age-zero receipt, exact one-unit ordinary debit and the full 36-slot/component layout expected after that debit. Staging and RETURN use real native SWAP sends with later exact full joint slot receipts and current owned menu/empty-cursor gates. Original selected slot/main hand can be restored only in that same original owned state. Unknown effects retain their evidence indefinitely without guessed timeout success, resend or reacquisition.

The crop catalog models one physical mature wheat/carrot/potato/beetroot plant per cycle and six output pairings. Pure core types retain Java-17-compatible, Minecraft-free contracts. Sources have no fictional seed prerequisite or byproduct credit. Actual ordinary stock reserves the real planting unit while retaining protected stock/components. Loaded, safe, permitted crop/farmland and bounded movement remain required, subject to the P3 height refusal. The original-job budget retains 32 cycles/ten active minutes across pause/replan/queue/project ownership; the 30-second cycle and three-route bounds remain.

Real movement/AIR input leases bind the launched runtime/session/process/goal/filter/player/world. Exact handler observations compare actual input head and private predecessor. R4 retains the true kernel N→O restoration wait before manual BotInput captures O. The manual exception accepts only the original Engine-owned BotInput and its actual predecessor/context under broad native quiescence. There is no synchronous restoration rewrite, inferred predecessor ownership, arbitrary foreign controller activity or reacquisition to repair an unproved chain. Unavailable observations withhold effects; foreign input/controller/menu/selection/session observations permanently revoke rights.

Early crop tick P:2053–2104 / M:2420–2472 retains the original nativeRun metadata. Replaced native session abandons metadata without issuing old cleanup. Pause/AIR retain passive evidence; owned AIR alone controls movement and forbids crop edits, pickup, stage or RETURN while that input owns movement. Rights loss and unproved harvest/plant/SWAP acknowledgment keep the actor retained. Broad ownership is checked before movement cancellation; cleanup cannot cancel a foreign native controller to regain admission.

Safe release captures original authority before clearing the handle at P:2081–2083 / M:2448–2450. Crop Delivered is explicitly rejected. Yielded must match original job/catalog/output, current ordinary count and original provenance session. This is an absolute stock census, with no claimed recipient or causal pickup. Global STOP precedes targeted cancellation and all subsequent reset/replan; the ordinary goal compares the original acquisition demand.

Against the captured baseline, the port preserves Travel global STOP/targeted cancellation, optional food/shield original suppliers and real floors, diagnostics/log latch, completion observer/read-only getters, and animal AIR/UNKNOWN behavior. NativeRun retains TravelFinished. Actual animal gains still yield ordinary stock without attribution. Crop uses the shared native acquisition barrier and does not create a second scheduler. The later peer-helper drift above remains an installation concern.
